ArtRoot.Name: Art folder
ArtRoot.Hint: Folder holding one subfolder per character (portrait.webp, expressions/ and an optional vn-stage.json). See docs/art-format.md in the module.

SafetyBackground.Name: Safety-net background
SafetyBackground.Hint: Set once as the scene's own background when a scene becomes a stage, and used as its first background. Players still see it if the module fails.

GroupFolders.Name: Group background folders
GroupFolders.Hint: A folder every group finds its backgrounds in by itself, when it exists. {group} stands for the group's name, for example scenes/{group}/. Leave blank for none.

OpenWindow.Name: Open the Stage window
OpenWindow.Hint: Opens the VN Stage window (GM only). No key is set by default.
